extraction.notes: RUN-2026-02 stage 7 extraction (rules 0.5) of the Moldova passages and the in-scope horizontal passages addressed to all enlargement countries, following MKD-EU-2025-002 (E21). The RUN-2026-01 items (-0001 to -0016) are unchanged and listed in earlier_extractions; the twelve horizontal passages it extracted that also concern Moldova are quoted again as this run's own items (-0025 to -0036), and the AI factory antenna sentence as -0022. Keyword screen of the whole text (Moldova, Republic of Moldova, Moldovan, enlargement countries, plus digital, cyber, artificial intelligence, AI, e-government, e-services, electronic, data protection, personal data, interoperability, broadband, 5G, connectivity, identity, wallet, online, ICT, internet, technology, roaming, workers, EURES, social security, EHIC, labour, migration). Extracted: the opening of cluster 2 (pages 3 and 26), Roam Like at Home (pages 14 and 26, theme_doubtful pending M4), Moldova's resilience approaches including cybersecurity (page 10), the AI factory antenna (page 17) and the Annex III priority schedule for provisional closure of Chapters 10 and 2 (page 38). Not extracted: passages only on the Western Balkans (WiFi4WB, pages 13; extension of Roam Like at Home to the Western Balkans, page 14; Common Regional Market, page 13), which do not cover Moldova; the Growth Plan and Reform and Growth Facility paragraphs (pages 13-14), which name digitalisation only in a list of reform areas; SEPA (digital finance) and the Common Transit Convention; labour migration and secondary movements (pages 9-10), irregular migration outside the Chapter 2 boundary; misuse of new technologies by criminals and online radicalisation (page 8, cybercrime rule); EIT Community Hubs to open in Moldova (page 16), innovation, not a theme area; skills and labour shortages (page 17), not linked to an in-scope recommendation; 'Ukraine and Moldova opened four clusters each' (page 21), which names no cluster; the general call to work on closing benchmarks for all chapters (page 38); the Annex III gradual integration paragraph (page 38), which names digital connectivity in a list; Annexes V and VI, whose only digital rows are basic digital skills. Difference from MKD-EU-2025-002: that file left out horizontal passages that do not name Moldova; this file includes those addressed to all enlargement countries, as the task set for stage 7 asked. Listed for G4. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one in the Communication and plus two in the annexes. Second pass (PC-05): a keyword check of every page by the lead agent, against the RUN-2026-01 second pass, added 2 items for 20 first-pass items (10 per hundred) (-0037, page 4; -0038, page 18), both theme_doubtful; see review/RUN-2026-02/second_pass/MKD-EU-2026-009.csv.

items.extraction_note: Horizontal: addressed to all enlargement countries, Moldova among them. 'Economic security requirements above' refers to the previous sentence (item -0035), which includes cybersecurity; Chapter 10 is named among three chapters, but chapter is left empty because the claim concerns access to gradual integration as a whole. theme_doubtful because cybersecurity is implied, not named. Added at the second pass (keyword check, 2026-11-05).

pass2.classification_note: G4 seed kept; regional; cybersecurity is one of the economic security requirements under Chapter 10; theme_doubtful cleared on the G4 mapping

extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4 and themes 1.3 (RUN-2026-01 refresh, E18), following MKD-EU-2025-002. Multi-country Communication covering ten enlargement countries, with Annexes 1 to 6 (pages 31-62): only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, artificial intelligence, e-government, e-services, electronic, data protection, personal data, interoperability, broadband, 5G, gigabit, roaming, wallet, identification, trust services, online, ICT, internet, workers, social security, EURES, EHIC, labour, connectivity, technology) and full reading of sections I.2 security and resilience (pages 9-10), II (pages 11-19), III, IV and V (pages 19-30) including the North Macedonia paragraph (page 28). Annexes 1 to 4 (roadmaps for Montenegro, Albania, Moldova and Ukraine) do not concern North Macedonia; Annexes 5 and 6 have no in-scope indicators (the 'basic digital skills' rows are not linked to an in-scope recommendation, R2). Period covered left empty: the register gives none. Text-file page numbers are printed page numbers plus one in the Communication and plus two in the annexes. Left out: cybercrime and misuse of new technologies by criminals (pages 8-9, R21); the Roam Like at Home extension to Ukraine and Moldova (page 14) and other passages only on Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina or Türkiye; SEPA (digital finance); the Common Regional Market's 'digitalising procedures' and general references to the green and digital transitions in the Growth Plan and IPA (incidental); digital skills (page 17). The North Macedonia paragraph in the conclusions (page 28) has no Chapter 2 or technology claim. Roam Like at Home (refresh plan, LIM-0037): the Communication says only that 'Work is advancing on extending the scheme to the Western Balkans' (item -0004); it does not repeat the Council's June 2026 authorisation of negotiations. The country report adds the Commission's February 2026 proposal (MKD-EU-2026-007, page 66). Second-pass check by a different agent (G3 condition 2 of GATE-0004): 2 items added (-0015, a general sentence split from -0011, and -0016, the horizontal passage on cybersecurity and interconnected networks, page 10), both theme_doubtful and out of scope; -0011 trimmed to one sentence; 14 first-pass items, yield 14 per hundred. See review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/MKD-EU-2026-009.csv.
